MEASUREMENT_STATUS: REAL measured numbers (one model, one prompt version) - not the full D5b family comparison.
success_rate_caveat: This is the D4 CODE-CHECK pass rate over 107 evaluation trials on the CURRENT 45-case, 69%-negative eval set, for the v2 prompt - not yet a large-sample production success rate, and not the number for every prompt: the SAME model with the deliberately worse v1 prompt scores only 27.1% on the identical trials (results/descriptors/comparison.json) - a much larger gap than on the earlier, mostly-positive 35-case set (45.5%), because this set is dominated by cases needing an EXACT trigger/missing label, which v1's schema cannot supply even when it reaches the right underlying decision. v2's 2 residual failures are non-reproducible flakes, not a systematic gap - see docs/D4_EVALUATION.md and STATUS.md.
